claude-code.rationale: Orchestrator launches and supervises external agent CLIs through compiled adapters, with structured Chat on a subset. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, ao CLI, Orchestrator Cloud.

codex.rationale: Orchestrator launches and supervises external agent CLIs through compiled adapters, with structured Chat on a subset. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, ao CLI, Orchestrator Cloud.

cursor.rationale: Orchestrator launches and supervises external agent CLIs through compiled adapters, with structured Chat on a subset. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, ao CLI, Orchestrator Cloud.

opencode.rationale: Orchestrator launches and supervises external agent CLIs through compiled adapters, with structured Chat on a subset. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, ao CLI, Orchestrator Cloud.

aider.rationale: Orchestrator launches and supervises external agent CLIs through compiled adapters, with structured Chat on a subset. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, ao CLI, Orchestrator Cloud.

pi.rationale: The cited shipped-harness table explicitly lists Pi with Terminal UI and Chat. Readiness depends on installation, credentials and permissions.

grok.rationale: The cited shipped-harness table explicitly lists Grok with Terminal UI and reviewer support. Readiness depends on installation, credentials and permissions.

antigravity.rationale: Agent Orchestrator v0.14.10 ships an Agy adapter that builds interactive Antigravity launches, supports native session resume and installs workspace hooks. This is the local/self-hosted adapter. The existing Cloud restriction to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode remains unchanged.

byo-subscription.rationale: Local projects use installed agent CLIs with existing subscription sign-ins. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Cloud.

local.rationale: Daemon and agents run on the user’s computer. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Cloud, Self-hosted remote host.

own-server.rationale: A VM or other machine joins by bootstrap or ao remote-host link; sessions stay on that machine. Labelled experimental. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Cloud, Self-hosted remote host.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Orchestrator Cloud runs worker and orchestrator sessions in hosted sandboxes, from Starter. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Cloud, Self-hosted remote host.

worktree.rationale: Each Git session gets its own worktree, sharing the object database. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Cloud.

parallel-runs.rationale: Each task runs as its own worker session, and pricing states unlimited local agents. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Cloud.

coordinator.rationale: Product-owned orchestrator and worker sessions delegate, message and report across harnesses. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, ao CLI.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Five-field cron or RRULE with an IANA time zone. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, ao CLI.

sso.rationale: SSO and team management are marked coming soon, meaning not yet built. Scope: Orchestrator Cloud.

pr-workflow.rationale: Workers open PRs; sessions discover and link them, or claim explicitly. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9.

review-ui.rationale: Files shows workspace and PR changes. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Cloud.

license.rationale: Apache-2.0 for desktop, CLI and AO Mobile. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, ao CLI, Orchestrator Mobile for iPhone, iPad and Android, Orchestrator Cloud.

self-hosting.rationale: Local app and VM host are self-run. Cloud is vendor-run, apart from a Pro bring-your-own Coder deployment. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Cloud.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: Settings switches, which also govern a paired phone. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Mobile for iPhone, iPad and Android.

free-tier.rationale: Free plan with unlimited local agents. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Cloud. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to agent-orchestrator:OWN-08; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

starting-price.rationale: Free plan with unlimited local agents. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Cloud. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to agent-orchestrator:OWN-08; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

laptop-independent.rationale: Closing a view does not stop work; Cloud agents continue while the computer sleeps. Local work needs the host awake. Scope: Orchestrator desktop v0.14.9, Orchestrator Cloud, Self-hosted remote host.

roles.rationale: The first-party Cloud policies give organization admins documented billing permissions, including canceling or changing plans. This is Cloud organization-admin scope; the local daemon is single-user.

free-plan.rationale: Pricing page lists Free $0 beside paid Starter, Pro and Enterprise.

byok.rationale: API-key sign-ins work; usage billed by the provider.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete public pricing cards list Free, monthly Starter/Pro and custom Enterprise. The public offering includes no no-paid-plan ADE pricing model; provider usage fees are separate.

per-seat.rationale: The complete public pricing cards list Free, monthly Starter/Pro and custom Enterprise. The public offering includes no per-seat ADE pricing model; provider usage fees are separate.

usage-based.rationale: The complete public pricing cards list Free, monthly Starter/Pro and custom Enterprise. The public offering includes no usage-based ADE pricing model; provider usage fees are separate.

compute.rationale: The complete public pricing cards list Free, monthly Starter/Pro and custom Enterprise. The public offering includes no compute ADE pricing model; provider usage fees are separate.

one-time.rationale: The complete public pricing cards list Free, monthly Starter/Pro and custom Enterprise. The public offering includes no one-time ADE pricing model; provider usage fees are separate.

web-client.rationale: The migration contract replaces the old browser dashboard with packaged desktop. A loopback HTTP API and embedded preview browser do not establish a released browser client.

issue-tracking.rationale: The scoped persistence, API, delegation and board bind each task to a worker session; there is no independent product-owned issue entity.
